description: Authoritative list of pure-governance CMMC L2 / NIST 800-171 R2 controls — controls satisfied PRIMARILY by policy / procedure documents (not by OS configuration, cloud inheritance, or technical implementation). Codex's adjudication engine treats these as the doc-driven set; QMS's CMMC tagging admin UI uses this list to populate the per-control picker. Historical name 'Governance-18' is legacy — actual count is 17 (3.4.3 reclassified to hybrid).

consumer_notes.qms: Vendor a copy at server/src/lib/cmmc/governanceControls.json (or .ts re-export) with a `// SOURCE: codex repo @ <commit-sha> / governance-18-controls.json` header. Bumped via PR when codex publishes a new version.
consumer_notes.drift_policy: Codex side is authoritative. When the list changes (Rev 3 ships, control reclassified, etc.), codex bumps this JSON's version + last_updated, opens an issue against QMS to pull the new copy.
consumer_notes.out_of_scope: Hybrid-governance controls (3.4.3 + 16 others) are NOT in this list — they require BOTH OS evidence AND governance docs, and codex adjudicates them via a separate path. QMS does not need to track them in the CMMC tagging admin UI for v1.
